run_medical_question_pairs_preprocessing: run the MedicalQuestionPairs dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_medical_question_pairs_dataset: create a MedicalQuestionPairs classification dataset instance that loads medical question pairs from HuggingFace
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace medical questions dataset split to a list of question pairs with similarity labels
get_train_test_lines: get train and test line splits from the medical questions dataset using an 80/20 random split
load_medical_questions_dataset: load the medical_questions_pairs dataset from HuggingFace datasets library for classification tasks
